name: Facial Action Timing Analysis
description: Analyzes onset, apex, and offset timing of facial action units (AUs) — AI expressions have unnatural temporal dynamics.
algorithm: Facial Action Timing Analysis 분석 알고리즘
mechanism:
This method analyzes the temporal dynamics of facial action units for deepfake detection:

1. **ActionUnit시간적Profiling**: Each FACS action unit activation is profiled over time, measuring onset velocity (rate of muscle contraction initiation), peak intensity, sustain duration, and offset velocity. Natural facial actions follow stereotyped temporal profiles governed by neuromuscular physiology.

2. **TimingRegularity분석**: Natural facial actions show specific timing distributions — spontaneous smiles onset in ~0.5s, reflexive blinks in ~0.1s, surprise reactions in ~0.25s. The method checks whether detected AU timing falls within physiologically valid ranges. AI-generated facial actions may show unrealistic timing — too fast, too slow, or uniformly timed.

3. **Inter-AU시간적Coordination**: When multiple AUs activate together (e.g., smile = AU6 + AU12), their relative timing follows biomechanical constraints — zygomatic major contracts before orbicularis oculi. The method checks inter-AU timing relationships. Deepfakes may produce simultaneous AU activation lacking natural temporal offsets.

4. **Action-ReactionTiming**: In conversation, facial actions follow a temporal structure: reaction expressions appear after the triggering event with characteristic delays (200-500ms for emotional reactions). The method evaluates whether expression timing is contextually appropriate. AI-generated faces may show incorrect action-reaction timing.

5. **시간적대칭성평가**: Natural facial actions show slight bilateral temporal asymmetry — the dominant side activates marginally earlier. The method measures left-right onset timing differences. Perfect bilateral temporal symmetry or excessive asymmetry indicates AI generation artifacts.
parameters: 분석 유형: 자동 통계\n점수 범위: 0(실제)~100(AI 생성)
source: 디지털 포렌식 및 AI 콘텐츠 탐지 관련 동료 검토 연구 기반.
useCase: AI 생성 콘텐츠를 탐지하기 위한 다중 신호 분석 파이프라인의 일부로 사용.
strengths: • 연구 기반 방법론\n• 빠른 계산 속도\n• 다른 탐지 방법과 보완적
limitations: • 정확도는 입력 품질에 따라 변동\n• 다른 방법과 함께 사용하는 것이 최적
